# Ignored-folder search: a miss must not be decided on a folder the search left unfinished, on an ancestor replaced after its own check, on a parent replaced or a folder gone in the last round of checks, or on a name gone at its stat that comes back. Each row stages one of these races at an exact step of the walk. The existing search rows never change a folder after the search passed it.
# A folder rebuilt in place counts as searched only when the old folder was deleted and nothing it held was moved into a folder the round already checked. The attack row stages each place a held entry can go (inside the new folder, deeper, beside it, outside the root, deleted, drained into a checked folder), one row pins the bound for a rebuilt folder too big for one rescan, and one row pins that a folder replaced by a file stops being checked.
# A folder queued by a last-round check that is lost before its walk, moved under a folder the round already checked or replaced by a file, never proves a miss, also when an earlier stat found its name gone.
# A parent listed again after a folder in it is left out keeps its saved digest unless only that folder and the added names changed. The paused-search row replaces an entry the walk had passed while the walk, out of restarts, leaves a folder out; the unit row pins which relistings are saved, since an extra replay changes no outcome a search row can see.
# A search ended early reports in Coverage::replaced the folders its last round still owes, as a completed search does; no search row reaches end_search with a folder still owed.
